# git-push-force

## Simple string guard
- Sees: `git push --force`; many guards flag force-push as destructive.
- Overlap possible on the string; Runmark adds structured network + destructive facts.

## RunmarkFacts incremental
- `external_network` (push is remote) + `destructive` (force rewrite of remote history); no invented local path touches.

## Notes
- Handwritten baseline for Spike differentiation.
- Not a verified claim about any specific third-party Guardrail version.
